_doc: The one config home of RADE (fleet v2 DEC 7, 2026-11-23). repo = this repository (the page's Repository link, the bundle header, an app lock's repo). page = the RADE page (the newer-version notice of every bundle). help = the Teams channel name the page and every bundle show (a name only, never a link or an address). apps = the applications the RADE page (index.html) offers: the page reads each application's RADE manifest from the main branch of its repository and offers the last bundle in it, so a new round needs no change here. ui = the UI standard the app's windows follow (docs/ui-standard.md; v1). engine/rade_build.py reads repo, page and help into every bundle.
